response.overview: To add a passenger to your Cunard Cruise, contact customer service.You must call +1-888-315-9585 (US) Cunard Cruises or your travel agent to request the addition. +1-888-315-9585 (US) If you booked directly, sign in to your Guest Account to manage your reservation and check guest details. +1-888-315-9585 (US) Adding a passenger depends on cabin capacity and availability, and additional charges may apply. Contact Cunard Cruises +1-888-315-9585 (US)  early to confirm availability, applicable fees, and required passenger information before finalizing your updated booking. You can add a passenger to an existing Cunard Cruise booking by calling Cunard Cruise Customer Service at +1-888-315-9585
